summary.zh: 小口短颈丰肩瘦底，存酒器，线条极简。
summary.en: A slender-based wine vase of classic plum-vase silhouette.

body.zh: 小口圆唇，唇线一圈青花弦纹。
body.en: A small round lip encircled by a cobalt string band.

body.zh: 肩腹绘缠枝花卉，青料浓处可见铁锈斑。
body.en: Interlocking scrolls sweep the shoulder; the thick cobalt shows rust-coloured spots.
